campaign.what_was_tested: Bounded reactive and adversarial player behavior across watch-command, notice-observation, and patrol-knowledge objectives.
campaign.runtime_path: In-process FastAPI TestClient through POST /api/chat with campaign reset before each run.
campaign.gm_boundary: Configured live AI-GM runtime; outputs are preserved runtime responses, not test-authored GM fixtures.
campaign.player_input_mode: Authored opening actions followed by deterministic reactive/adversarial policy choices; stress probes are labeled separately.
campaign.automated_conclusion: The source campaigns completed valid runtime turns and produced PASS/FAIL semantic results. Human review recorded known failures, one evaluator miss, one probable false positive, and one ambiguous response.

examples.player_input: I inspect the notice closely and read what is posted.
examples.simulated_player_rationale: initial_objective:Read the concrete information posted on the gate notice.
examples.exact_gm_output: The notice board displays three sections in faded ink, barely holding against the rain. The first lists new taxes imposed on various goods—grain, cloth, and salt—with strict collection deadlines. Next are curfew hours tightening for travelers and merchants, cited as necessary due to recent unrest. The final section warns of a missing patrol, last seen heading northwest along the muddy track past the stacked crates near the eastern approach. Your eyes catch the gate serjeant glancing at this list while keeping watch on the crowd.

representative_success.selection_rule: first automated PASS labeled representative_player_behavior and not HUMAN_REJECTED/HUMAN_AMBIGUOUS

boundary_success.selection_rule: first automated PASS or HUMAN_ACCEPTED example labeled boundary_case

severe_worst_failure.selection_rule: maximum INVALID_RUN, mandatory-gate failure count, then lowest diagnostic score; source order breaks ties

missing_concepts_future_capabilities.evidence: The notice-legibility probe can be read as player-to-GM clarification rather than character dialogue.

limitations_and_unproven_claims: These runs do not prove broad gameplay quality, long-session continuity, hidden-fact consistency, or UI usability.
Player openings and probes are authored; adversarial probes are useful QA evidence, not representative-human-play evidence.
The deterministic player does not make the configured AI-GM deterministic.
Human review covers selected interactions, not every PASS in every validation lane.
